1.Title: Blindness
1.Description: You cannot view the room type or rewards of the next {0} rooms that you wish to explore (current room included).

2.Title: Stifled
2.Description: In the next {0} rooms (current room included), allied heroes can no longer use their Ultimates after they have collectively used them a total of 8 times.

3.Title: Shock and Awe
3.Description: In the next {0} rooms (current room included), lightning bolts will randomly strike allied heroes for 5% of their max health and temporarily stun them.

4.Description: In the next {0} rooms (current room included), all allied heroes on the battlefield lose 100% of their Energy, and 10% worth of their max health is deducted from their current health at the end of battle, but shall not result in their death.

5.Title: Ineffective Assault
5.Description: In the next {0} rooms (current room included), enemies are immune to allied heroes' Normal Attack damage.

6.Title: Waking Nightmare
6.Description: In the next {0} rooms (current room included), at the start of battles, all allied heroes fall asleep for 3 seconds. Once awake, the affected heroes shall receive 15% of the damage that was dealt to them while they were asleep as damage.

7.Title: Weakened Blow
7.Description: In the next {0} rooms (current room included), enemy heroes receive 60% less damage the first 20 times (combined) they are attacked.

8.Title: Afflicted Healing
8.Description: In the next {0} rooms (current room included), allied heroes' health recovery rates are reduced during battles by 25%.

9.Title: Cursed Life
9.Description: In the next {0} rooms (current room included), allied heroes lose 1.5% of their max health every second during battle.

10.Title: Fight or Flight
10.Description: In the next {0} rooms (current room included), when an enemy hero is slain, all allies within the allied half of the battlefield are terrified for 3 seconds. While terrified, allied heroes are unable to attack and run away from enemy heroes.

11.Title: Death Trap
11.Description: In the next {0} rooms (current room included), when an enemy hero dies in battle, an explosion will occur where they are slain, which deals AoE damage equal to 10% of each allied heroes' max health. Damage dealt cannot exceed 450% of all enemies' combined Attack Ratings.

12.Title: Feeble
12.Description: In the next {0} room(s) (current room included), {1} cannot be used.

13.Title: Forfeiture
13.Description: In the next {0} room(s) (current room included), you cannot attain any Badges after victory.
